# Generated gRPC stubs — do not edit

`mls_client.pb.swift` and `mls_client.grpc.swift` are generated from
`mls_client.proto` (mlswg/mls-implementations, vendored in the mls-rs
checkout) by `protoc` with `protoc-gen-swift` and `protoc-gen-grpc-swift-2`.
Checked in as source so CI needs no `protoc`. Regenerate with
`Scripts/generate-interop-stubs.sh`.
